description: Get the graph edges into or out of one item: a law, an article, a ruling, an opinion, a research study or a Gazette issue. Use this to walk citations and amendments directly, instead of only what get_law and get_article attach automatically. Not legal advice.

direction.description: "to" (edges that name this item as their target) or "from" (edges this item itself carries)

relation.description: narrow to one relation (e.g. "cites", "amend", "repeal"); omit for all

name: get_links
